class.name: DedicatedServerEntry
class.brief_description: Boots a headless fixed-world LAN server from an authored scene.
class.description: Assign the same world, world ID, and player scene on the server and clients. Launch the server scene in a headless Godot process with [code]--crimson-role=server[/code] as a user argument. The scene boots a playerless authority and announces readiness after the world is loaded.

members.member: The gameplay scene the server loads before accepting players. Assign the same scene on clients.
The actor scene used for connected players. No local player is created on the server.
Leave enabled to keep the scene's default Godot relay policy. Disable when all gameplay messages must go through the authority and guests use the game's authoritative player roster.
The LAN admission settings and default UDP port. A valid launch port override takes precedence.
The nonempty ID that identifies the starting world to joining clients.
